worldcombat.skill.hail.summary: Freeze the sky's moisture into hard hailstones: everything not Ice with open sky above is pelted down over passes, while solid overhead cover such as eaves and rock ceilings shelters those beneath it; Ice bodies are merely coated in frost.
worldcombat.skill.hail.use.0: Suppress foes without an icy body
worldcombat.skill.hail.use.1: Pelt a crowd that is standing in the open
worldcombat.skill.hail.use.2: Flush sheltering foes back into the open
worldcombat.skill.hail.description.0: Press a hailstorm of radius %1$s blocks onto the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hail.description.1: Inside the storm every non-Ice body is pelted once every %3$s for %1$s of its max health (at least 1 point), but only those with an unobstructed column up to the cloud take it: an eave or rock ceiling blocks that pass and the hail shatters on the roof, while side walls do not block. Ice bodies take no pelting and are merely frost-clad. Every body that enters is marked as pelted, and the mark lingers %2$s after leaving, counting as a harmful status that cleansing effects can remove.
worldcombat.skill.hail.description.2: Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.hail.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to drop the hail, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.hail.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hail.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hail.preference.squall: On = squall: wider storm (x1.15), harder pelt (x1.3), faster passes (x0.82) and denser hail (x1.4), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = fine hail: smaller, lighter and sparser, but lasts longer (x1.22) and cools down 10 ticks sooner.
worldcombat.skill.hail.preference.ai.max: The companion only calls hail while a threat is within this distance; lower drops it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
worldcombat.skill.hail.preference.ai.adv: Push the storm at the foe
On, the storm is pressed between you and the threat so the fighting line falls in the hail; off, it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
worldcombat.skill.hail.preference.ai.lea: On, a companion holding its station will step out to drop hail.
worldcombat.skill.hail.description.weath: While the storm lasts, the covered ground counts as hail weather and the light dims; moves that read the sky treat the area as hail.
